description:

 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity

description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. On-site Technology Senior Support Specialist (Senior Associate) Enterprise Technology (ET) Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world-class technology infrastructure. Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact. The opportunity As part of Enterprise Technology, the On-site Technology Support s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service. The On-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation. Your key responsibilities Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware). Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents. Resolve complex incidents associated with firm-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences. Acts as a lead to less experienced specialists Provide after-hours service for escalated issues or tasks from the Service Desk or supervisor. Perform asset management activities (procurement, receipt, inventory, tracking, distribution, etc.) as assigned and in accordance with firm policy and EY Technology process. Anticipates technology support issues and acts to creatively to prioritize tasks, interpret solutions and apply knowledge to facilitate the development and implementation of technical business solutions to complex customer technology needs and issues Works independently on small projects and assesses the local needs of area offices and responds appropriately Document and track the status of enquiries, coordinate appropriate responses and follow-up to ensure customer satisfaction Work effectively as remote hands for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting. Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents. Understand the Firm s business and organization sufficiently to anticipate and resolve end user technology issues that affect productivity of Firm personnel This role is required to physically work in an EY office. Skills and attributes for success Advanced analytical skills are required to address end-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk-up issues. Decision making responsibilities can be made to address issues impacting large numbers of customers within the supported geography and communicate effectively to customers as necessary. Experience in leading projects and overseeing contribution and performance of project members A Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience is desirable. To qualify for the role you must have Exceptional communication, interpersonal, organizational, project and time management skills. Excellent customer service attitude. Demonstrated multitasking abilities in a fast-paced environment Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel. Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers. Approximately 4-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support What we offer As part of this role, youll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here s a snapshot of what we offer: Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Electrical Maintenance Technician
description:
We are looking for a skilled and certified Electrical Maintenance Technician with a valid C-Licence to join our Engineering team. The role is responsible for the safe and reliable operation, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and troubleshooting of plant electrical systems, covering equipment from HT yards to production machinery . The position will also play a key role in ensuring statutory compliance, electrical safety, and adherence to applicable state electrical regulations , including validation and certification of electrical installations and modifications. Key Responsibilities 1. Electrical Operations & Maintenance Execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of electrical equipment, including: Transformers HT/LT panels MCC/PCC panels VCB/ACB circuit breakers Motors and associated control systems Diagnose and resolve complex electrical faults in: Motors Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) Control circuits and instrumentation interfaces Read and interpret electrical schematics, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring diagrams, and engineering drawings for troubleshooting and installation activities. Monitor and ensure reliable operation of utility equipment such as Diesel Generator (DG) sets, air compressors, and associated electrical systems . Monitor plant power quality and maintain Power Factor (PF) close to unity through effective operation and maintenance of APFC panels. Coordinate with production and other engineering functions to minimize electrical downtime and ensure uninterrupted plant operations. 2. Statutory Compliance & Licensing Act as the designated C-Licence holder and undertake responsibilities related to electrical installations and modifications within the scope permitted under applicable regulations. Ensure electrical maintenance and installation activities comply with applicable state electricity regulations, electrical safety standards, and statutory requirements . Coordinate with the State Electricity Board and Electrical Inspectorate for inspections, audits, load sanctions, approvals, and licence-related requirements. Maintain statutory records and documentation, including: Electrical inspection records Earth-pit testing records Statutory registers Relevant Form F/H submissions Electrical equipment testing and certification records Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of applicable electrical licences, certificates, and statutory approvals. 3. Electrical Safety Implement and strictly enforce Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during electrical maintenance activities. Ensure compliance with Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems for electrical work. Conduct regular inspections of electrical installations, panels, cable systems, earthing systems, and electrical rooms to identify potential safety hazards. Ensure appropriate PPE and safe working practices are followed during electrical maintenance and troubleshooting. Support electrical safety audits, risk assessments, and corrective action implementation. 4. Reliability & Continuous Improvement Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring electrical failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, reduce breakdowns, and minimize electrical-related production downtime. Monitor maintenance performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, breakdown frequency, and maintenance compliance . Maintain proper maintenance records and ensure timely closure of maintenance activities. Drive 5S and good housekeeping practices in electrical rooms, workshops, and plant utility areas. Participate in energy conservation and electrical efficiency improvement initiatives. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HT/LT electrical systems and industrial electrical maintenance . Hands-on experience with transformers, HT/LT panels, MCC/PCC, VCB/ACB, motors, VFDs, and control circuits. Knowledge of PLC-based control systems and industrial automation. Ability to read and interpret SLDs, electrical drawings, and wiring diagrams . Good understanding of electrical safety, LOTO, PTW, earthing, and statutory compliance . Knowledge of DG sets, compressors, APFC panels, and plant utilities. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a manufacturing/plant environment. Good coordination and communication skills. Educational Qualification Diploma / ITI in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent. A valid and relevant C-Licence is mandatory . Additional electrical safety certifications will be an advantage. Experience 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in industrial/manufacturing electrical maintenance . Candidates with hands-on experience in HT/LT systems, plant maintenance, electrical statutory compliance, and troubleshooting will be preferred. Key Performance Areas (KPIs) Electrical equipment availability and reliability Reduction in electrical breakdowns and downtime Preventive maintenance compliance Improvement in MTBF and reduction in MTTR Power Factor and energy efficiency Statutory compliance and timely documentation Electrical safety and LOTO/PTW compliance 5S and housekeeping standards Timely completion of corrective and preventive maintenance activities

description:
Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Stores Manager with approximately 10+ years of experience in manufacturing stores and warehouse operations , preferably from the valve, Oil & Gas, engineering or industrial manufacturing industry . 
 The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in ERP-based stores management, inventory control, material traceability, warehouse systems, inward/outward material control and coordination with Purchase, Production, Planning, Quality and Finance . 
 Experience in a valve manufacturing environment , particularly with API 6D Ball, Plug and Butterfly Valves, will be highly preferred. 
 The ideal candidate should be systems-oriented, ERP proficient and data-driven , with the ability to establish strong inventory controls and ensure accurate real-time stock information. 
 Stores & Warehouse Management Manage the complete stores and warehouse operations for raw materials, bought-out components, consumables, WIP and finished goods. Establish and maintain systematic storage, identification and retrieval of materials. Ensure proper material segregation and storage based on material type, status and usage. Take ownership of ERP-based stores and inventory transactions . Ensure all material movements are accurately recorded in the ERP system. Ensure real-time inventory visibility through the ERP system. Identify and eliminate gaps between physical stock and ERP stock . Establish controls for minimum/maximum stock levels and reorder requirements. Ensure proper identification and traceability of: Heat numbers Material codes Batch numbers Lot numbers Purchase orders MTCs Inspection status Material status Job/work-order references Plan and conduct periodic physical stock verification . Implement cycle-counting systems for critical and high-value materials. Reconcile physical inventory with ERP records. Investigate and close inventory variances. Support internal, customer and external audits. Maintain proper documentation for stock verification and reconciliation. Maintain accurate records for: GRNs Material issue slips Material return notes Stock transfer documents Inspection status Rejection/quarantine records Scrap records Inventory reconciliation Cycle-count records Material traceability records Dispatch documentation Approximately 10+ years of experience in Stores / Warehouse / Inventory Management . Strong experience in a manufacturing environment . Experience managing a stores team and multiple warehouse activities. Proven experience in ERP-based inventory management . Strong understanding of material traceability and inventory controls. Experience handling high-value engineering/manufacturing materials. Education Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Logistics, Materials Management or related discipline. Additional qualification in Materials Management / Supply Chain / Logistics will be an advantage.
